user_story: As a user, I want to interact with buttons on the Buttons page so that I can test the click, double-click, and right-click functionalities. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'sp5Bi' (text: 'Click Me'), the appropriate action occurs. 2. When I double-click the button with id 'doubleClickBtn' (text: 'Double Click Me'), the appropriate action occurs. 3. When I right-click the button with id 'rightClickBtn' (text: 'Right Click Me'), the appropriate action occurs.
